name: Greenergy Data Centers GRE DC1 (Tallinn/Hüüru)
developer: Greenergy Data Centers OÜ / MCF Group Estonia OÜ
notes: Harju/Saue vald, Hüüru, Alajaama tee 1; 14,500 m2 floor area, 31.5 MW full build-out across three buildings, EN50600 Level 3/4; first building opened 2022; MCF Group Estonia OÜ reg. 14069314. DCD/trade press + first-party; official EHR/Saue permit verification still pending for Grade A.

name: Greenergy/MCF expansion (+22 MW)
developer: MCF Group Estonia OÜ / Caverion Finland
notes: Harju/Saue vald Hüüru campus expansion: EUR 50M agreement adds 22 MW IT power and cooling to reach campus total 31.5 MW; Caverion main contractor (electrical, cooling, ventilation, fire protection); data hall completion expected autumn 2026. Contractor release + trade press.

name: Telia Eesti data center (Utilitas-adjacent, Peterburi mnt)
notes: Harju/Tallinn edge: ~EUR 10M data center built next to Utilitas CHP plant on Peterburi maantee, planned 2019-2021, powered by Utilitas. Trade/local press (ERR, Postimees) + Telia Digitark first-party mirror. Capacity not public.

name: WaveCom Data Center
notes: Harju/Tallinn, Endla 16 (10142 Tallinn); Tier 3 or higher design, automated management; WaveCom AS reg. 10756058. First-party facility page + hostsearch directory.

name: Elisa Tallinn data center (Adala 4)
notes: Harju/Tallinn, Adala 4; catalog address (DataCenterMap/datacenterplatform) + Elisa first-party confirms data-center services in Estonia. Candidate operating facility; EHR/TPR verification still needed for Grade A count.

name: INFONET DC
notes: Harju/Tallinn, Laevastiku 3R; purpose-built Tier 3 carrier-neutral DC, ~512 racks in 4 stages (~4 MW per catalog), since 2018; INFONET DC OÜ reg. 12501440. First-party page + catalog specs.

name: CITIC Telecom CPC DataHOUSE@Tallinn
notes: Harju/Tallinn, Sõle 25; CITIC Telecom CPC colocation data center connected to Western Europe and Asia; first-party operator page + catalog address.

name: Linxdatacenter Tallinn
notes: Harju/Tallinn, Sõle 25 area; colocation provider active in Estonia since 2001 (Baxtel catalog + Beehosting partner page). Catalog-grade; needs operator/EHR confirmation.

name: Burfa Tech Narva high-performance computing center
notes: Ida-Viru/Narva, Enefit Technology Park; 7 MW HPC/data-processing center, phase I completed summer 2019, phase II 2020; described as largest HPC center in Northern Europe at the time; AI-monitored operations. Trade press + first-party (burfa.com).

name: Astrec Data Jõhvi
notes: Ida-Viru/Jõhvi, Tartu põik 5; 1.5 MW per catalog; NATO/state-grade security colocation claim (LinkedIn); Pilvio cloud pages list data centers in Tallinn and Jõhvi. Catalog + company sources; official EHR verification pending.

name: Narva Datacenter (FairyHosting)
notes: Ida-Viru/Narva, Mihail/Ak. Maslovi 1 (Kreenholm area per datacenterplatform). Catalog-only seed; FairyHosting first-party colocation page references Estonia but not specifically a Narva facility. Candidate only - needs EHR/Narva or first-party facility confirmation.

name: Sunly Risti Data Center Campus
notes: Lääne/Lääne-Nigula vald near Risti: planned ~180 MW (184.5 MW secured per project site) AI data center campus, 36 ha, six 30 MW modules, ~EUR 1.7B investment; detailed-plan application submitted to Lääne-Nigula municipality March 2026; grid connection via Risti solar-park substation (Elering). Planned only - do not count as operating/under construction.

name: Evecon Lihula data center (planned)
notes: Pärnu/Lihula area: renewable developer Evecon plans a data center with up to 100 MW electricity consumption near Lihula; two developers interested (ERR). Early-stage/planned; no construction or permit evidence yet.

name: Levira Tartu data center
notes: Tartu: Levira first-party states it operates three data center locations - two in Tallinn and one in Tartu - supporting IT infrastructure and service continuity. First-party facility existence; capacity not public.

name: Telia Company Valga data center
notes: Valga/Valga, Võru tänav 116a (catalog). Catalog-only legacy telco entry; needs Telia first-party/EHR confirmation before counting as a live commercial facility.

name: Telia Company Karksi-Nuia data center
notes: Viljandi/Karksi-Nuia, Pärnu maantee 6a; ~3 MW total power per Inflect catalog. Catalog-only legacy Telia Carrier facility; needs first-party/EHR verification.
